title: Member hub headers start to share one look: Events loses its photo band for the plain member header with its search and buttons, the Quest loses its banner image, and Spaces you run loses its photo band

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: survey all the headers; a uniform look and feel with buttons and search targeted at each area; leave the Space headers alone; omit image headers on pages that don't need them. Phase 1 of the header survey (header-survey.md).

detail: Under Frequency the Events hub drew a 360px photo band with light text over a scrim while every other hub (Circles, Marketplace, Journeys, the Vault) used the kit's plain .head, and the Quest stacked the operator's banner image above its head. Events now renders ev-hero.is-plain: no photo element, dark kit type on the page at the h1 size the other hubs use, the search field and its buttons (New Event, Calendar, Subscribe, Manage) unchanged, glass buttons drawn as ordinary kit buttons. The Quest no longer renders the banner. Later phases bring the DAWN-template pages (Practices, Channels, Members, Journal, Notifications) and the missing per-area searches onto the same header. /spaces/operating (Spaces you run) spread the index hero ladder's photo into IndexTemplate, washing out its headline; under Frequency it now renders the template's plain header with the title, meta and Create a space. 2026-10-15 integration: the probe now follows the shared IndexHeader replacement (SCAN-946) and the owner-requested header photo restoration (SCAN-938), while preserving the no-photo hub and full-width rail checks.
